description: First night: wood, a creeper, lava, diamonds, dawn

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri joined Steve's world, next to him in a birch forest.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve said in chat: "hey! help me get some wood before dark"

data.message: hey! help me get some wood before dark

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri: 20/20 health, 20/20 food, empty-handed, at 112 64 -40.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve is chopping birch trees a few blocks away.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri picked up 6 birch logs.

event.subject: world
event.summary: The sun is setting.

event.subject: world
event.summary: Night fell and Kiri and Steve are standing in an open field with no shelter.

event.subject: self
event.summary: A creeper started hissing right behind Kiri.

event.subject: world
event.summary: The creeper blew up, leaving a crater where Kiri had been standing.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri took 6 damage from the blast.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri got clear; nothing hostile nearby.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve said in chat: "LMAO you screamed"

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve is digging straight down.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve dug straight down into a lava pocket and burned to death. His items are gone.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve said in chat: "noooo my stuff"

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri: 14/20 health, 19/20 food, empty-handed, at 118 64 -36.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve respawned and is running back to her.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri killed a zombie with her bare hands.

event.subject: world
event.summary: It's midnight.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri finished building a small dirt hut.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve is mining in a cave under the hut.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve found diamonds: four diamond ore in the cave wall.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve said in chat: "DIAMONDS!!!"

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri slipped off a ledge in the cave.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri took 8 fall damage.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri is down to 6/20 health and backing away from the edge.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri: 6/20 health, 17/20 food, empty-handed, at 131 31 -29.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve broke three blocks off Kiri's dirt hut to get out of the cave.

event.subject: world
event.summary: It started to rain.

event.subject: self
event.summary: A skeleton's arrow hit Kiri.

event.subject: self
event.summary: Kiri was shot dead by a skeleton and respawned at the spawn point, empty-handed.

event.subject: world
event.summary: The sun is coming up.

event.subject: user
event.summary: Steve said in chat: "we survived the night! mostly"
